subject.title: Settings: add unified usage and spend dashboard

question: Should Usage & Spend remain a dedicated persisted Settings pane, or should its model be integrated into the existing Overview surface?
rationale: The implementation is substantial and well-proven, but the contributor explicitly requested this placement decision and no discussion comment records the permanent product choice despite steipete’s branch rework.

options.title: Keep Dedicated Pane
options.body: Approve Usage & Spend as a permanent Settings destination after repairing the cost-tracking opt-out and reviewing shared snapshot upgrade behavior.

options.title: Integrate Into Overview
options.body: Retain the dashboard model and history work but move the presentation into the existing Overview to avoid another top-level Settings destination.

options.title: Pause The Surface
options.body: Keep the reusable data-model improvements separate and defer the dashboard UI until the product hierarchy is settled.

recommendation.title: Keep Dedicated Pane
recommendation.body: Approve Usage & Spend as a permanent Settings destination after repairing the cost-tracking opt-out and reviewing shared snapshot upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the owner rework and the supplied commits that define the current product and data-contract shape.
